task: In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "live_chat_copy test" on the multivariate flag "live_chat_copy". Hypothesis: "Get it today" increases checkout completed versus "Buy now". The primary metric "checkout_completed" should increase, and "refund_requested" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.

changes.after: "Get it today" increases checkout completed versus "Buy now"

finalText: DONE: Created experiment "live_chat_copy test" (id 13) in Production on `live_chat_copy`, status "created" and not started. Primary metric `checkout_completed` is set to increase, and guardrail `refund_requested` is set to not increase. Traffic is split 50% to "Get it today" and 50% to control ("Buy now"), with rollout disabled. Production's flag state was not touched.
